questions.question: (3x²y − 2y² + 4xy²) − (x²y − 5xy² + 2y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 3 − (1) = 2; xy²: 4 − (−5) = 9; y²: −2 − (2) = −4. Result: 2x²y + 9xy² − 4y².

questions.question: (2x²y + 4y² − xy²) − (x²y + 2xy² + 3y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 2 − (1) = 1; xy²: −1 − (2) = −3; y²: 4 − (3) = 1. Result: x²y − 3xy² + y².

questions.question: (3x²y − 2y² + 4xy²) − (2x²y − xy² − 2y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 3 − (2) = 1; xy²: 4 − (−1) = 5; y²: −2 − (−2) = 0. Result: x²y + 5xy².

questions.question: (x²y + 5y² − 3xy²) − (−2x²y + 4xy² + y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 1 − (−2) = 3; xy²: −3 − (4) = −7; y²: 5 − (1) = 4. Result: 3x²y − 7xy² + 4y².

questions.question: (4x²y − y² + 2xy²) − (3x²y + 5xy² − y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 4 − (3) = 1; xy²: 2 − (5) = −3; y²: −1 − (−1) = 0. Result: x²y − 3xy².

questions.question: (2x²y − 3y² + xy²) − (−x²y − 2xy² + 2y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 2 − (−1) = 3; xy²: 1 − (−2) = 3; y²: −3 − (2) = −5. Result: 3x²y + 3xy² − 5y².

questions.question: (5x²y + 2y² − 4xy²) − (2x²y + xy² − 3y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 5 − (2) = 3; xy²: −4 − (1) = −5; y²: 2 − (−3) = 5. Result: 3x²y − 5xy² + 5y².

questions.question: (x²y − 4y² + 6xy²) − (3x²y + 2xy² − 4y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 1 − (3) = −2; xy²: 6 − (2) = 4; y²: −4 − (−4) = 0. Result: −2x²y + 4xy².

questions.question: (3x²y + y² − 2xy²) − (−2x²y + 3xy² + 4y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 3 − (−2) = 5; xy²: −2 − (3) = −5; y²: 1 − (4) = −3. Result: 5x²y − 5xy² − 3y².

questions.question: (2x²y − 5y² + 3xy²) − (4x²y − xy² − 5y²). Which of the following is equivalent to the expression above?
questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign and combine like terms: x²y: 2 − (4) = −2; xy²: 3 − (−1) = 4; y²: −5 − (−5) = 0. Result: −2x²y + 4xy².
